description: This file defines the 'SavingsOfficerAssignmentHistory' class, which models the historical record of savings officer assignments associated with a savings account within the Apache Fineract project. It includes details such as start and end dates, and methods for managing and querying assignment data.

classes.name: SavingsOfficerAssignmentHistory
classes.description: Represents a historical record of the assignment of a savings officer to a savings account, including start and end dates, with methods for managing these assignments.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Creates a new instance of SavingsOfficerAssignmentHistory with the specified account, savings officer, and start date.

methods.name: setSavingsOfficer
methods.description: Sets the savings officer for this assignment record.

methods.name: isSameSavingsOfficer
methods.description: Checks if the assigned savings officer matches a given staff member.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the assignment.

methods.name: setStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the assignment.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the assignment.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the assignment.

methods.name: matchesStartDateOf
methods.description: Checks if the assignment's start date matches a given date.

methods.name: isBeforeStartDate
methods.description: Determines if a given date is before the assignment's start date.

methods.name: isBeforeEndDate
methods.description: Determines if a given date is before the assignment's end date, considering null end dates.

methods.name: isCurrentRecord
methods.description: Checks if this record is the current assignment (i.e., end date is null).

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Retrieves the creation date, with backward compatibility handling.

methods.name: getLastModifiedDate
methods.description: Retrieves the last modified date, with backward compatibility handling.
